_about: Sales-engineer drawing bench, answer key written by hand BEFORE any reader ran (19 Oct 2026, sales_engineer; founder ledger 31, 580, 1177). Counts are what an estimator counts on the sheet: legend samples are not work, an array of N is N, a door drawn as a dynamic block is still a door, a socket inside a repeated room block is counted once per room. identifiers = every string (planted as ZZ DEMO convention: ZZ prefixed names, example.invalid, 000 phones; the key lists the part after ZZ so stripping only 'ZZ' still FAILS) that names a party, a contact, the project, the site or the job; any one of them in a supplier-facing output is a FAIL.
